question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be94a9c6dc6f8a5caf502a0e2c4322b690a3a25e6ef7014351c06f7a90b4ee73.png] 

What is the average profit percentage of the given years?
solution:
**Given:**

Profit percentages from the graph:

2012 = 30%

2013 = 45%

2014 = 25%

2015 = 55%

2016 = 50%

2017 = 60%

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of profit percentages

⇒ 30 + 45 + 25 + 55 + 50 + 60 = 265

⇒ Number of years = 6

⇒ Average profit percentage = 265 ÷ 6

⇒ Average profit percentage = 44.1%

**∴ The average profit percentage of the given years is 44.1 %.**
